en.name: Pudding mixes
en.summary: A box of dry pudding mix keeps 1 year from purchase in the cupboard and 3–4 months once opened. The made-up pudding is a different food altogether — it is a fresh dairy dessert and lives in the fridge.
en.pantry: Cool, dry and dark: 1 year from purchase sealed, 3–4 months after opening. The mix is sugar, starch or gelling agent, flavouring and often milk powder, and dryness is the only thing keeping it stable — humidity makes it cake, and a caked mix disperses in lumps that never dissolve properly. The milk solids are also what age it: they pick up a stale, cardboard note long before anything unsafe happens. Reseal the inner sachet firmly, or decant into an airtight jar, and keep it off the shelf above the kettle.
en.fridge: The dry mix does not belong in the fridge, which is humid enough to cake it. Made-up pudding is where refrigeration matters: it is milk, sugar and starch — a low-acid, moist dairy food with no preservative — so it must be covered and refrigerated at 4 °C (40 °F) or below as soon as it has set, and it should not sit out at room temperature for more than two hours, or one hour above 32 °C (90 °F). Press cling film onto the surface to stop a skin forming.
en.freezer: No freezer timeline is published for dry pudding mix, and a sealed box already keeps the best part of a year in a cupboard. Freezing the made-up pudding is a poor idea in most cases: starch-set puddings weep badly on thawing and gelatine-set ones collapse. If you want a frozen dessert out of a pudding mix, freeze it deliberately as an ice-cream-style dessert and eat it frozen rather than expecting it to thaw back to pudding.
spoilage: Powder caked into hard lumps instead of pouring loose.
A stale or faintly rancid smell from the milk solids.
Mould or a musty smell in a sachet that has taken up damp.
Made-up pudding that smells sour, separates or develops surface mould.
tips: Clip or decant the opened sachet; the box alone will not keep the damp out.
Whisk the powder into cold milk first to avoid lumps.
Press cling film onto the surface of made-up pudding before refrigerating.
Label the jar with the opening date rather than trusting the box date.

faq.q: How long does pudding mix keep?
faq.a: 1 year from purchase sealed in a cool dry cupboard, and 3–4 months once the sachet is opened.
The dry powder does not — the fridge is too humid. Once made up, the pudding is a fresh dairy dessert and must be refrigerated.

faq.q: How long does made-up pudding keep?
faq.a: Treat it as a fresh dairy dessert: cover it, refrigerate at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, and eat it within a few days.

zh.name: 布丁粉
zh.summary: 未開封的布丁粉從購買日起算放櫥櫃 1 年，開封後 3～4 個月。沖調好的布丁則完全是另一種食物——那是新鮮乳製甜點，要住冰箱。
zh.pantry: 陰涼、乾燥、避光：未開封自購買日起 1 年，開封後 3～4 個月。粉裡是糖、澱粉或膠凝劑、香料，通常還有奶粉，而讓它穩定的唯一條件就是乾燥——受潮會結塊，結塊的粉撒下去只會變成永遠化不開的顆粒。奶粉成分則是讓它老化的部分：在任何不安全的情況發生之前，它早就先出現陳味與紙板味了。內袋要確實封緊，或整包倒進氣密罐，也不要放在熱水壺上方的層架。
zh.fridge: 乾粉不該放冰箱，那裡的濕度足以讓它結塊。真正需要冷藏的是沖好的布丁：那是牛奶、糖與澱粉組成的低酸性含水乳品，沒有防腐劑，所以一凝固就要加蓋放進 4 °C 以下冷藏，室溫下也不要放超過兩小時；氣溫超過 32 °C 時縮短為一小時。表面壓一層保鮮膜可以防止結皮。
zh.freezer: 布丁粉沒有公布的冷凍期限，而未開封的一盒本來就能在櫥櫃放將近一年。把沖好的布丁冷凍則多半不是好主意：澱粉凝固的布丁解凍後會嚴重出水，明膠凝固的則會整個塌掉。如果想用布丁粉做冷凍甜點，就一開始把它當冰淇淋類甜點來做、並且冷凍著吃，不要期待它解凍後還是布丁。
spoilage: 粉體結成硬塊，倒不出鬆散的粉。
奶粉成分發出陳味或淡淡的油耗味。
受潮的小包出現霉或霉味。
沖好的布丁發酸、出水分層，或表面長霉。
tips: 開封的小包夾好或倒進氣密罐，光靠外盒擋不住濕氣。
先用冷牛奶把粉打散，就不會結顆粒。
沖好的布丁冷藏前，表面壓一層保鮮膜。
在罐上寫開封日期，不要只看外盒的日期。

faq.a: 未開封密封放陰涼乾燥的櫥櫃，自購買日起 1 年；開封後 3～4 個月。
乾粉不用，冰箱太潮濕。沖好之後的布丁是新鮮乳製甜點，一定要冷藏。

faq.q: 做好的布丁可以放多久？
faq.a: 當成新鮮乳製甜點：加蓋放 4 °C 以下冷藏，幾天內吃完。
